limits: Synthetic dense-overlap workload; not FPS or1000/10000/50000-node acceptance.
No renderer algorithm changed; pixel hashes/counters identical. Render timing variation is not claimed as a speedup.
Small sample counts do not establish production p95; shared cloud scheduling and GC can add outliers.

remaining_limits: Full image/paint alpha, luminance masks, stroke-only masks, mask effects/subtrees, and group/text geometry proxy are not unified by this change.
geometry outline and stroke_geometry still flatten/expand with0.01 local tolerance; Boolean snapping and transform-aware edit outline need a separate numerical contract.
Smoothing path fixed subdivision, browser/DPR behavior, GPU execution, all AA phases, and full Figma parity are not proven.
Extreme curves whose bounds contain the pointer still retain the existing explicit subdivision budget; this patch does not add a new analytical point-in-curve solver.
